content: Written 2026-10-06 20:24, self-approved; adds only the refinement protocol to prerun_review_row4_c5fef9f_20261006.csv and prerun_review_rows31_syn_c5fef9f_20261006.csv (everything else there holds). Code 45f96bb = c5fef9f + F2. Real row 4 v3 (c5fef9f, F1) stopped at 20:20:50 in session A's refinement: superseded, not evaluated. Reason (user, relayed by the supervisor): no post-processing that the official method does not do; 'official uses it, we may use it' -> exactly as GaME.

GaME run.py:36-37: optimize_model(refinement_iters, refinement=True) once after all runs; in its Flat setting run2 continues from run1's unrefined map. Before (F1, cc76961): a refinement after every session, carried into the next one -- ours, not GaME's. GaME paper (arXiv 2506.06909, Table 8, per the supervisor): refinement is optional; PSNR 23.70/23.46 -> 24.55/24.26, depth L1 7.2/6.6 -> 7.9/6.6 (no geometric gain); RTX 3090.

Sessions before the chain's last one end without refinement (their timeline.pkl / checkpoint_<s>.pt carried and evaluated as they are = pre_ref). After the last session (real C, synthetic B): the pre_ref outputs are saved first, then finish_session (the published refinement) once, then timeline_post_ref.pkl (same snapshots, the final one re-rendered) and checkpoint_<s>_post_ref.pt. Main protocol for geometry and change metrics: pre_ref; post_ref reported as a supplement for the last session. G5, INSIDE, T1 unchanged (the method's session-end steps, not GaME's refinement).
No number changes; refinement_iters 30000 and densification as flat.yaml when the refinement runs.

eval_row.sh on the run (pre_ref, all sessions); post_ref_view.sh builds RUN/post_ref (earlier sessions linked, the last one's timeline/checkpoint = post_ref) and eval_row.sh scores it with SES=<last> (synthetic: the whole view, A identical to pre_ref). Same tools for every row.

smoke_45f96bb_real (A->B, 300 frames), real_row4v4, real_row3v3, real_row1v3, syn_row4v4, syn_row1v3, syn_row3v3: per session timeline.pkl + checkpoint_<s>.pt; the last session also timeline_post_ref.pkl + checkpoint_<s>_post_ref.pt; eval_real / eval_syn and post_ref/eval_*; synthetic runs also <run>.vram.log (10 s).

Real A->B, 300 frames each, row 4 flags: exit 0; no 'Refinement' progress before '== real_a' in the log; '== real_b: post_ref ok'; session_b/timeline_post_ref.pkl and checkpoint_b_post_ref.pt exist; eval_row.sh (SES='a b') and the post_ref view (SES=b) both write G1.json, G1_tsdf.json, changes, ghost, retention for their sessions. Any miss: stop, fix, re-smoke.

Without the refinement after A and B a real row saves ~2 x (8-22) min; the one refinement after C as before (v2 C refinement peak 14.7 GB at most, in A). Synthetic: the mapping itself peaked at 7.66 GB on 09-30 (5 Hz, no refinement); the final refinement on synthetic B may run out of memory: then pre_ref is complete, run.json records it with the peak, and the queue continues (no rerun). Disk: used inside 333 GB of the 449.7 GB vhdx; superseded run dirs cleaned after each evaluation (records/cleanup_20261006.csv).

pre_ref numbers are not comparable with the F1 runs (v2/v3, rows 1/3 of 10-06): rows 1/3/4 are all re-run under F2 and compared with each other. The A1 stop rule against v2 first echo (row-4 review) cannot be applied across protocols: A1 stays (official GaME), and row 4 is judged by the six claims against rows 1/3 under F2. Expected: real pre_ref G1 recall of A/B slightly below F1's (no densification), precision similar or higher; synthetic mapping fits 16 GB.

Code 9e50f83 = 45f96bb + --g8-holdout + eval/game_render_metrics.py; decided before real row 4 v4 starts (supervisor: GaME's own metrics are its home metrics, reported the official way, all three rows alike). queue14 was stopped at 20:27:50 before v4; its F2 smoke ran to its end.

GaME run.py: train run1 then run2 in one process (Gaussians, keyframes, occlusion masks carried in memory); evaluate once after the last run, pre_ref and post_ref: the last run's training frames ('train') and its held-out frames ('test': datasets.py:404-440, run2 every 10th frame but the first). Metrics src/utils/mapping_eval.py: PSNR = 20 log10(1/sqrt(MSE)), LPIPS alex normalize=True, MS-SSIM data_range 1, depth L1 = mean |render - gt| in scene units; averaged over frames; final model rendered, black background.

--g8-holdout: in the chain's last session (real C, synthetic B) frames n % 10 == 0, n != 0 are not integrated by the backend nor seen by the layer (evidence, D1 front end); their stamps in run.json. game_render_metrics.py: the same formulas on that session's train and test frames, inputs as the backend integrates them (crop, pixel step, scale); two stated differences: each frame rendered with the map of its stamp (T1 rows; rows 1/3: every Gaussian = GaME's final model), depth L1 over measured pixels only (real frames have invalid and people-masked pixels; Flat has depth everywhere, so it is the same formula there). Reported for pre_ref (checkpoint_<last>.pt) and post_ref (the post_ref view).

Our geometry and change evaluation reads fixed reference files per session (eval/registry.yaml: results/abc_eval_v2/geometry/<S>_reference_1cm.ply, <S>_domain.npz; synthetic GT likewise), made independently of what a backend integrates. The held-out frames stay in that reference; the map loses every 10th frame of the last session, whose surfaces the neighbouring frames 33 ms apart see. Earlier sessions are not affected.

GaME's change detection uses SAM masks (sam_masks.h5). Here all three rows use the dataset's GT instance masks (the same input for every row and backend, as the TSDF method): row 3 is therefore not GaME's published SAM configuration.

A chain runs in one process and carries the map object in memory to the next session (run.py: b_prior = final_map), as GaME does; checkpoints are only for --resume after a failure. Round trip checked on smoke_45f96bb_real (run after its exit at 20:38:59, before 20:45): A's final snapshot rendered from checkpoint_a.pt equals the in-process one exactly (background points, labels, normals with NaN-aware equality, object points), and the Adam state (6 groups, step 248, exp_avg/exp_avg_sq) is in the checkpoint; RNG states are saved too.

Real A->B, 300 frames each, row 4 flags + --g8-holdout: exit 0; no refinement before the end of A; '== real_b: post_ref ok'; session_b/run.json g8_holdout frames = 29; eval_row.sh (SES 'a b') and the post_ref view (SES b) both write render_b.json with train 271 / test 29 frames and finite metrics, besides the files of the F2 smoke list.

game_render_metrics renders every frame of the last session once per protocol (real C 7216 frames, synthetic B 3555): ~10-20 min per row and protocol on the GPU, inside eval_row.sh (one job at a time).
